definitions.explanation: A patient who visits a hospital for treatment without being admitted.

examples.japanese: {外来|がいらい}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many outpatients come early in the morning.
Today is my outpatient visit day.

examples.japanese: {外来|がいらい}{種|しゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Invasive species are affecting the ecosystem.

notes:
{外来|がいらい} has two main meanings: outpatient (medical) and foreign origin.

SENSE 1 - Medical:
- {外来|がいらい}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: outpatient
- {外来|がいらい}⟦{診療|しんりょう}→診療：14183_shinryou⟧: outpatient care
- {外来|がいらい}⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧: outpatient reception
- ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧{外来|がいらい}: emergency outpatient

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入院|にゅういん}{患者|かんじゃ}→入院患者：24805_nyuuinkanja⟧: inpatient

SENSE 2 - Foreign origin:
- {外来|がいらい}{語|ご}: loanword (foreign-origin word)
- {外来|がいらい}{種|しゅ}: invasive/introduced species
- {外来|がいらい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: foreign culture

USAGE:
In medical contexts, {外来|がいらい} alone often means "outpatient department/services."
